# Project Governance 4.2.1-rc.1

This release candidate repairs blocked pre-push preparation and retains the evidence needed to
recover a proven stopped preparation run.

- Native pre-push captures the exact single pushed commit and remote comparison from Git's hook
  input. Unrelated live or untracked archives no longer enter the committed context packet.
  Required committed inputs cannot be supplied by live files, and the capture limit stays fixed.
- Review hunks use the same committed candidate. Secret checks cover both the complete pushed
  candidate and exhaustive live/index inputs, including secrets present in only one of those views.
- Detached preparation failures retain their bounded cause instead of replacing it with a generic
  incomplete-worker result. A failed preparation releases only its own check reader.
- Finite recovery for the affected 4.2.0 generation requires the exact original archive, tree,
  worker and records, an absent worker process, and a stable oversized-input witness. It preserves
  originals, unrelated readers and unknown outcome. It never manufactures a passing check.

Qualification follows the normal 4.x local publication path. The retained source checkpoint passed
1,147 engine, 82 continuity and 100 proof-script cases; 16 optional browser cases were skipped.
Focused corrections, independent correctness/security and recovery-cohesion reviews, and the exact
archive's offline package verifier passed. Installed push proof passed all three large-archive,
live-only-secret and candidate-only-secret cases. Exact compiled recovery proof passed.

Native validation commands still run in the live checkout. Committed packet capture does not prove
an isolated committed build. Hosted CI, native host/device adoption, live provider compatibility,
accepted ordinary development outcomes and token/time savings are not qualified by this release.

This candidate is a prerelease and is not the latest stable release. Adoption is deliberate and
does not upgrade projects, move chats, retire live owners or change runtime pins. The separate
startup replay, delayed-cleanup, packet-diagnostic and added-file capture repairs remain pending
review, integration and archive qualification.
